Cabin Safety

เครื่องกระตุกหัวใจอัตโนมัติ

A portable device that analyzes cardiac rhythm and delivers electrical shocks to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A portable device that analyzes cardiac rhythm and delivers electrical shocks to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

Operational example

Cabin crew retrieved automated external defibrillator after passenger collapse; device applied and medical assistance coordinated on ground.
